class.name: MaszynaHeightmapTerrainChunk
class.brief_description: A chunk of the original's heightmap terrain, as a pack file holds it.
class.description: A square of 250 m of the original's heightmap terrain (heightmap::chunk_data): a grid of heights of its own point spacing, the palette indices of up to 8 layers painted over it and their weights - read from a pack file by [MaszynaHeightmapTerrainPack].

method.name: build_weight_images
method.description: The weights of the first four layers and of the next four as the channels of two RGBA8 images, [param side] samples along a side (the chunk's own when 0). A chunk without paint gives a texel of its first layer alone.

method.name: get_average_weights
method.description: The weight of each layer in use over the whole chunk, 0..1 - how it looks from afar; 8 of them.

method.name: get_cells
method.description: The cells of its grid along a side; it has [code](cells + 1)^2[/code] heights.

method.name: get_height
method.description: The height of the grid point ([param x], [param z]), clamped to the chunk.

method.name: get_heights
method.description: The heights of its grid points, in rows of growing z.

method.name: get_key
method.description: Where the chunk lies, in chunks.

method.name: get_layers
method.description: The palette indices of the layers in use, the used ones first.

method.name: get_paint
method.description: Its paint samples along a side, less one; 0 when it is covered with its first layer alone.

method.name: get_spacing
method.description: Metres between the points of its grid.

method.name: get_weights
method.description: The weights of the layers in use, planar: [code](paint + 1)^2[/code] a layer, the weights of a sample adding up to 255.

method.name: key_get_corner
method.description: The corner with the lowest coordinates of the chunk of [param key] (heightmap::chunk_corner()).

method.name: key_get_pack
method.description: The pack holding the chunk of [param key] (heightmap::pack_of()).

method.name: set_data
method.description: Takes what a pack file holds of the chunk: its grid of [code](cells + 1)^2[/code] [param heights] in rows of growing z, its [param paint] samples along a side less one, the palette indices of its [param layers], the [param weights] of each layer in use, planar.
